$comment: Single source of truth for the Date Picker API. Every framework package is tested against this file.
name: date-picker
title: Date Picker
description: A field that opens a calendar to pick a date or a range.
thumb: Due dateNov 14, 2026

value / defaultValue.description: "YYYY-MM-DD", or { from, to } for a range.
value / defaultValue.html: the calendar's data-value and the hidden input

label.description: Visible label. Without it, pass an aria-label.

name.description: Adds a hidden input: "YYYY-MM-DD", or "from/to" for a range.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: The button opens a calendar; choosing a day closes it. In HTML, add data-vin-date-picker and include vinui.js once.

examples.title: Range
examples.description: Pick the first and last day; the field updates when the range is complete.

examples.title: Placeholder, error, disabled
examples.description: A placeholder until a date is chosen, an error that is read out with the field, and a disabled picker.

a11y: The button opens a dialog (aria-haspopup="dialog") in the browser's popover, so Esc and a click outside close it and focus goes back to the button.
The button's name is the label plus the chosen date, e.g. "Due date Nov 14, 2026".
Focus moves to the chosen day (or today) when the calendar opens; every Calendar key works inside.
Without JavaScript the button still opens the calendar; vinui.js adds choosing and placement.
